title: はないちもんめ (Hanaichimonme — Flower One Monme)
description: A traditional Japanese children's game song where two teams face each other, advance and retreat in rhythm, and take turns choosing a child from the opposing group. '一もんめ' refers to an old unit of silver currency weight (3.75g), suggesting flowers bought at a bargain price. One of the most iconic street games of pre-war Japan, still taught in elementary schools today.
